 The LPGA and PGA tours have season enders with a big difference in pressure. The CME Group Tour Championship is for the top 60 players on the LPGA, all of them playing for a $2 million prize. The PGA Tour finishes with the RSM Classic at Sea Island. The top 100 in the FedEx Cup Fall after the tournament keep full cards for 2027. The RSM Classic has most of the players on the top 100 bubble. It also has Brooks Koepka in his first fall event, along with newcomer like Blades Brown, Jackson Koivun and Ben James.
